_comment: Cape Jones living room furniture layouts. Owner directive 2026-10-18 ~10:10 CDT. POSITION 1 is the DEFAULT. Both restorable via apply_furniture_position.py. Coords are Blender world units (meters). Room: 7.0 x 6.0 m, walls at x=±3.5, y=+3.0 (WallBack face y=2.925). No front wall (camera side).

canon.chair: loungeChairRelax(Clone) at (2.653, 2.067->2.312, 0), yaw 270 deg. NEVER moves (canon placement locked per sit-targets). Sitter faces world -X = toward the TV/table zone.
canon.tv_parallel_gag: Owner 2026-10-18: the TV plays where WE (camera/audience) can see it, but he sits off to the side not really watching it. 'TV parallel' - he is not TV-adjacent, the TV is not facing him, but he looks toward the TV/table direction of the room. That is the joke.

TVConsole_Yaw.note: AUTO_BACK_TO_WALL: script sets rot to 0, measures assembly max Y, shifts so max Y = 2.925 (WallBack face). Screen (local -Y) faces south into the room.

bookcaseClosed(Clone).note: AUTO_BACK_TO_WALL: back (+Y side) flush to WallBack face y=2.925. Kept west of TV (no overlap: TV spans x[-1.3,-0.5], bookcase spans x[-3.15,-2.75]).

position_1.name: Backs against the wall (DEFAULT)
position_1.note: Owner 2026-10-18: 'the back of the TV and the back of the shelf was against the wall I liked that better'. TV console un-rotated (screen faces -Y/south into the room), back flush to WallBack. Bookcase back flush to WallBack, west of the TV. This is the default layout.

TVConsole_Yaw.note: Rotated 84.5 deg: TV screen (local -Y) faces +X/east toward the chair. Measured from living_room.blend 2026-10-18.

bookcaseClosed(Clone).note: Southwest area, off the walls. Measured from living_room.blend 2026-10-18.

position_2.name: TV and shelf facing the chair (walkthrough video layout)
position_2.note: Owner 2026-10-18: 'save the position where the TV and the shelf is facing towards the chair save that as position two'. This is the exact layout in the 2026-10-18 walkthrough video (cape-jones-living-room-walkthrough-preview-480p.mp4). Usable alternate.
